# nginxproxymanager_dead_host (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_proxy_host" "test" {
  domain_names = ["domain123.com"]

  http2_support  = true
  certificate_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_names` (Set of String) Domain names to accept. NPM stores these sorted, so the order doesn't matter.

### Optional

- `advanced_config` (String) Advanced NGINX config.
- `certificate_id` (Number) ID of the certificate to use.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the dead host.
- `hsts_enabled` (Boolean) Enable HSTS.
- `hsts_subdomains` (Boolean) Enable HSTS for subdomains.
- `http2_support` (Boolean) Whether to enable HTTP2 support.
- `ssl_forced` (Boolean) Whether to force SSL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the dead host.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) ID of the user which owns the dead host.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nginxproxymanager_dead_host 1
```
